Dialogs.Dialog: Oh, hello. It's me. Can you talk right now？
Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ Yeah, I can talk.
So, about today... I'm cooking dinner, so want to come eat at my place？
Great! Then I'll head home first to get things ready. Come over later, okay？
Really？ Yay♪ I'll get everything ready, so see you in a bit.
Yeah, I'm looking forward to it.
Oh, I see... That's a shame, but next time for sure, okay？
Come to think of it, isn't this the first time you've eaten at my place？
Was that so？ I'm starting to get a little nervous...
Make yourself at home tonight, okay？
There's a new dish I learned recently that I wanted you to try... So I'll make that♪
I've got a menu in mind, but if you have a request, I'm taking orders？
Oh yeah？ In that case... I learned a new dish recently, so I'll make that.
You sure？ Then I'll whip up something I think you'll like.
Then I think I'll request ▲メニュー▲.
Here you go, thanks for waiting! It's one of my best, so prepare to be amazed♪
Thanks for waiting! I think it turned out pretty decent this time？
Sorry to keep you waiting. I might've messed up a little, though...
I tried something a bit new. What do you think？
I put my own spin on today's dish. It's got a flavor all its own♪
Hey, can you tell I added my own little twist？
I tweaked this a bit. Following the recipe is fine, but I wanted to add my own personal touch.
I put a little extra effort into today's dish, you know♪
I hope you like my special take on it.
You know, Japanese food is definitely my specialty.
When it comes to Japanese cooking, I won't lose to anyone at school♪
I'm really good at seasoning Japanese food. I'm sure you'll love it？
Not to toot my own horn, but... I'm pretty good at making Western food, you know？
Think I could open my own Western diner？ Fufu♪
Once you taste my Western cooking, nothing else will ever compare♪
I'm really confident with Chinese food. I bet you'll think it's delicious, too.
I'm really confident with Chinese seasoning. It takes quite a bit of technique, you know？
Just leave the Chinese food to me♪
I'm good at this sort of cooking. Not bad, huh？ Fufu.
I've really enjoyed making this kind of food lately. I'm sure you'll love it？
After studying different recipes, I've gotten pretty good at this. How is it？
You can leave any kind of cooking to me♪ I'm sure I'll make you say it's delicious▼
I can make pretty much anything these days. Impressive, right？
So？ Aren't you lucky to have a girlfriend who can cook anything▼
Japanese food can go wrong with the slightest slip... How did it turn out？
I try to be extra careful with Japanese food... but it's pretty tricky.
I want to make it to your taste, but it's hard to get right. I tried my best, so will you give it a try？
I wonder what the secret is to seasoning Western food... Let me know if it's lacking, okay？
To be honest, I'm not great at making Western food... But I worked really hard to make you happy, okay？
Western food looks simple, so why is it this hard？ I hope my love can make up for it, though...
Chinese food is so tricky... I'm trying my best to match your tastes, though...
How do you get the flavors just right in Chinese food？ I did my best, but sorry if it's not to your taste？
I worked really hard on it, but is it okay...？ I might just be bad at Chinese food.
Maybe I'm just not cut out for this kind of food... I put lots of love into it, so I hope you'll eat it.
I tried my best, but maybe it isn't to your taste？ I need to practice this kind of food a lot more...
I'm still not very good at this sort of food... But I worked hard on it, so I'd be glad if you had some.
I feel like I'm in a slump with my cooking lately... I hoped adding love would help, but... how is it？
The seasoning just isn't coming together right... Will you still eat it anyway？
It's hard to make anything I'm confident in, but... will you still eat it？
Look, it's the matching dishes you gave me. We finally got to use them▼
I really love the dishes you gave me. Having the two side by side feels kind of... you know▼
(Her cooking really gives me energy. Feels like something good's gonna happen!)
So, how was my cooking？ I thought it turned out pretty well.
(She definitely has reason to be that confident...)
So, how did you like what I made？ You can be completely honest, you know▼
(Delicious, just like I'd expect from her...)
So, what'd you think of my cooking？ Compliments only, please... Just kidding♪
(Not like I have anything bad to say, though...)
Well now... care to tell me what you thought of it？
So, was my cooking... to your liking？
How was it？ ...Though I'm not really confident enough to ask.
(Well... I wouldn't exactly call it a success, but...)
Sorry... Today's food was pretty bad, wasn't it？
(I can't really say it was good, but...)
I'm sorry... I wanted to make you something proper.
(I should probably tell her what I think, right...？)
Really？ I knew you'd say that▼
How should I put it... It was good.
Wait, really!? As long as you're being honest, then okay, but...
Really？ I thought you'd like it more... but if it was good, that's fine.
Well, I thought it was good.
I think it was pretty decent？
Really？ Oh... So it turned out okay after all.
Not quite to my taste, I guess？
Wait... really？ And here I thought I nailed it... I'll try harder next time.
It wasn't... quite to my taste, I guess.
I see... Guess I need to study your tastes more, then.
Yeah... it really wasn't quite to my taste.
Right... But next time, I'll try to make it more to your liking.
Hey, about lunch... Would you rather not have a bento once in a while？
What are you talking about？ Bento is always the best.
Really？ Then I won't hold back from making them♪
Yeah. The cafeteria might be a nice change of pace.
Right？ That's way better than having a bento every day.
Quick question... Do you eat breakfast properly？
Mmm, sometimes I eat a lot, sometimes I skip it...
If it's okay with you, maybe I could come make it for you？
Hey？ I'd love to make you breakfast again... What do you think？
If you're okay with it, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, I'd love for you to come cook!
I'd love to cook for you♪ So I'll come over soon, it's a promise!
For breakfast... I think I'll try to manage on my own.
Oh, really... Okay, got it. I'll be rooting for you!
You know, I've really gotten into baking sweets lately. I want you to try some, too？
Really？ I'd love to have some!
Then I'll make something super delicious next time! Look forward to it, ▼
(I wonder what kind of treats she'll make？)
Hey？ I was thinking I'd like to come make dinner at your place again... would you mind？
I don't mind that at all!
Oh, good♪ Then I'll make something delicious for you! Look forward to it, ▼
Sorry... I was kind of hoping to handle it myself, if I can.
Oh... That's too bad. Still, it's great that you're trying to handle it yourself.
